name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 5 Nov: flu low but rising in labs and hospitals, COVID low and falling, RSV rising at baseline; next update 12 Nov
state: UKHSA's report of 5 Nov, covering 26 Oct to 1 Nov, says flu is low with variable trends: lab positivity rose to 7.6% from 6.8% and hospital admissions to 2.83 per 100,000 from 2.51, and a briefing note says flu activity is now above baseline. COVID-19 is low and falling, while RSV positivity rose to 2.9% from 1.6% at baseline levels. No widespread critical incidents were found as of 11 Nov, so Normal is kept pending the next report on 12 Nov.
for_you: Flu and RSV are expected to rise over the coming weeks. The NHS advises eligible people to take up flu, COVID-19 and RSV vaccines, and UKHSA advises staying home when unwell where possible.
rubric_hit: Flu low and ILI at baseline; no widespread critical incidents: Normal line
